subject.title: Beverly Hills Unified School District Board

text: As a second-generation Beverly Hills resident whose life has been woven into the community for more than three decades, I'm thrilled to be running for the Beverly Hills Unified School District Board of Education.

I graduated from Beverly Hills High School, and all three of my children are products of BHUSD. I have been a hands-on advocate for students. I've served as a room mom, PTA member, graduation committee member, and principal advisory committee member. I've organized and chaperoned field trips that took high schoolers to Europe, middle schoolers to Washington, D.C., STEM students to Space Camp, and Academic Decathlon competitors to Northern California.

I'm running because our school board has lost the community's trust, and our kids are paying the price. The board's focus must be our kids, not political or personal agendas. Every dollar must go to classrooms, not board member travel and layers of new administrators.
My priorities are clear:
1) RESTORE TRUST THROUGH OPEN, ACCOUNTABLE GOVERNANCE.
2) KEEP CAMPUSES SAFE & HEALTHY IN THE METRO ERA.
3) DELIVER ACADEMIC EXCELLENCE TO MAKE BHUSD #1.
I've lived BHUSD, as a student, a parent, and a volunteer. Now I am ready to serve it.
www.krugerforbhusd.com

text: Age: 39
Occupation: Parent

When I decided to run for a seat on the Beverly Hills Unified School District Board of Education, I found myself repeatedly returning to one simple idea: It's time for BHUSD to get back to school. Our district is well-resourced and full of talented people, and we have everything we need to be the "lighthouse district" we hear so much about – we just need the will.

My top-level priorities are a more comprehensive approach to student success that fosters academic achievement while also emphasizing personal growth, physical and mental health, and strong community connections for every single student; a restoration of trust between district leadership and the community; and a renewed focus on responsible and informed governance.

I also plan to build and improve upon existing initiatives, such as the newly-enacted educational technology policy and partnership with Special Olympics of Southern California. While encouraging on their own, these measures have the potential for even greater impact, and I look forward to turning that potential into reality.

text: As a parent of three BHUSD students, an attorney, and an education advocate, I am running for the Beverly Hills Unified School District Board of Education to strengthen academic excellence, support our teachers, and ensure every decision serves students' best interests.

For the past two years, I served on the Principal's Advisory Council, working with school leadership and parents to gain insight into the needs of students, parents, and educators. This experience has reinforced my belief that strong schools require high expectations, engaged families, exceptional teachers, and accountable leadership.

BHUSD must remain focused on rigorous instruction in reading, writing, mathematics, science, history, and critical thinking. I will advocate for effective tutoring and enrichment, strong academic standards, and technology only when it clearly improves learning. In TK–8, classrooms should prioritize teachers, books, writing, discussion, creativity, and human interaction, not unnecessary dependence on screens.
I will also promote responsible fiscal oversight, transparent decision-making, measurable goals, and clear communication.
My legal, business, community, and school leadership experience has prepared me to ask difficult questions and make principled decisions.
I respectfully ask for your vote for David Cienfuegos for the Beverly Hills Unified School District Board of Education.

text: It has been an honor to serve on the Beverly Hills Unified School District Board of Education and as Board President. As a BHUSD graduate and parent of three children in our schools, I have worked to ensure every decision puts students first and strengthens our schools for the future.

During my tenure, we have raised academic achievement, expanded educational opportunities, strengthened college and career readiness, and supported our exceptional teachers and staff. I have championed educational excellence while advancing responsible, developmentally appropriate approaches to technology and preparing students for a rapidly changing world.
I have prioritized student safety and security, strengthening protections across our campuses and working to ensure every student can learn in a safe and supportive environment.

I have also remained committed to fiscal responsibility, accountability, and strong oversight of taxpayer dollars. We have brought greater discipline to District finances, strengthened our construction program, and made significant progress completing the modernization of our schools and delivering facilities our community has long been promised.

There is more work ahead. I am running to continue raising academic standards, strengthening safety, protecting taxpayers, supporting educators, modernizing our schools, and providing every student with an exceptional education and opportunities to succeed.
